summary: This tutorial covers how to use the JCAMP Chemical Structure Editor for creating chemical structures and understanding periodic table trends. It starts by launching the JCAMP window from the desktop on Ubuntu Linux. Key features include buttons for selecting elements from the periodic table, which opens a detailed information box about the chosen element. The tutorial demonstrates creating xenon difluoride (XeF2) by drawing bonds between atoms. It also explains how to modify atomic properties using the atom popup menu, including changing isotopes and elemental properties like alkaline earth metals. The tutorial concludes with instructions on accessing molecular properties.
